negative_snippets:
Don’t go for this hotel.
I booked a Classic room and paid in advance. After reaching the hotel for check-in, they asked for extra money and behaved very rudely.
I complained to OYO and initially they agreed, but after the call ended, the hotel denied returning the extra charge. We had to complain again, after which they shifted us to the worst room available.
The staff entered the room without knocking, which is completely unacceptable and unsafe.
Cleanliness is very poor, and the room had a strong cigarette smell. Overall hygiene and maintenance are bad.
Also, some positive reviews seem fake—they take guests’ phones without informing them and post good reviews themselves.
Very disappointing experience. Not recommended at all.
